transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having trouble thinking clearly, I guess. At work I’ll look at a board packet or a vendor email and my head just feels… cloudy. Simple decisions I used to make quickly, I just kind of sit there staring.
How long have you been experiencing this cloudy feeling and difficulty making decisions?

About two weeks, I think. It got more noticeable after my husband retired and was suddenly home all day. Since then it’s been… a sharper change, first in my energy and confidence, and then this low, cloudy feeling.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed since your husband retired?
Yes… I guess I have. It’s not just since then, though. I’ve had these low stretches off and on for maybe about a year, but this latest one does feel more connected to him stopping work.
Would you say this low, cloudy feeling you're experiencing now is the worst you've felt in the past year?
I’m not sure. It feels pretty bad right now, but I don’t know if I’d call it the worst. It’s hard to compare.
Have you had any periods in the past year where you felt even worse than you do now?

There have been some rough patches over the past year, yes… they sort of come and go. I don’t know if any were clearly worse than now. This one just feels more tied to my husband being home after he stopped working.
Have you been enjoying activities that you normally find pleasurable?

Not much, no. I haven’t really wanted to go to my dance class, or look around the little galleries like I usually do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family… I just don’t feel like it, and those things usually make me feel like myself.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide recently?
A few mornings… I’ve had this thought that maybe it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. But I don’t want to hurt myself. I don’t have a plan or anything like that.
Would you say this current period of feeling low and cloudy is significantly worse than your usual low stretches over the past year?
I don’t know if I’d call it significantly worse. I’ve had these low stretches off and on for about a year… this one just feels more connected to things after my husband stopped working.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy doing?
Not really. I mean… the things I usually enjoy, like dance class or going to the little galleries, I just haven’t wanted to do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family doesn’t feel the same.
How many days in a row have you been feeling this low and cloudy?
About two weeks, I think. Since my husband retired and was suddenly home all day… that’s when it started feeling this way.
Are you still able to find pleasure in the things you do?

Not much, no. I haven’t really wanted to go to dance class or look at the little galleries… even cooking Sunday food for my family doesn’t feel like it usually does. Those things usually make me feel like myself.
Are there any small things that still give you pleasure?
Not much, honestly. Maybe little things here and there, but… the things that usually do it for me, like dance class, the galleries, cooking for my family, I just haven’t wanted them.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in, even if it's just a little?

Maybe… a little here and there. But not really the usual things. I haven’t felt like going to dance class, or looking at the galleries, or making Sunday food for everybody. Those are normally the things that make me feel like me.
Are you able to experience any pleasure at all right now?
A little, maybe… but not much. I still haven’t really wanted to go to dance class, or look at the galleries, or cook Sunday food for my family. Those are the things that usually feel like me.
Are you able to enjoy anything at all right now?

Not really… maybe little bits, but I haven’t wanted to do my dance class, or go look at the small galleries, or cook Sunday food for my family. Those are usually the things that make me feel like myself.
Do you feel that your low mood and cloudy feeling are interfering with your daily life most of the day?

Yes… most of the day, I think. I’m still getting to work, but I’ve had to slow down on decisions and ask my assistant to double-check vendor details. I put off a couple board items too… I just don’t trust my judgment much right now.
Do you feel your current low mood is markedly worse than your usual low stretches over the past year?
I’m not sure I’d say markedly worse… the low stretches have been coming and going for about a year. This one feels more tied to what happened after my husband stopped working, I guess.
Do you feel that your current low mood is worse than your usual low stretches over the past year?
I don’t know if it’s worse exactly. These low spells have been coming and going for about a year… but this one feels more connected to my husband stopping work.
Do you feel that your current low mood is severely impairing your ability to function in daily life?

Severely? No… I wouldn’t say that. I’m still going to work. I just have to slow down with decisions, and I’ve been asking my assistant to double-check vendor details. I did put off a couple board items because I don’t really trust my judgment right now.
Do you feel that your current low mood is severely impairing your ability to function in social life?
No… I don’t think severely. I’m maybe a bit quieter, not reaching out as much, but I’m not cut off from people or anything.
